summary: Rocket One Inc. filed an 8-K to increase the maximum aggregate offering price under its existing At-The-Market (ATM) Sales Agreement with H.C. Wainwright by an additional $5,257,000, bringing total capacity up to approximately $18.8 million including prior sales of $13.6 million. The filing includes a prospectus supplement and legal opinion from Sheppard Mullin. This is a routine shelf takedown expansion under an existing ATM facility, not a special situation. No structural changes, pricing terms, or corporate events were announced. The action is ordinary capital raising, and no risk-arb or special-situation angle applies.
